TechNovus 2026

TechNovus 2026 is the flagship hackathon organized by the Developers & Coders Club (DCC), NIT Agartala, as part of AAYAM — the annual techno-management fest of National Institute of Technology Agartala.

  • The event aims to foster technological innovation and solution-driven development by bringing together creative minds from across the country to build real, scalable, and impactful solutions.

Hackathon Domains:

  • The competition will be conducted across three core domains:
  • Web Development
  • Mobile Development
  • AI / Machine Learning
  • Open Track

Eligibility:

  • Open to all students and tech enthusiasts
  • Team Size: 2–4 members
  • Inter-college teams: Not allowed
  • Inter-specialization teams: Allowed
  • Problem Statement: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1U-Ft2CFEEeKybCXumKUjT9oaiLDkdso6?usp=sharing

Format & Rounds:

  • Round 1 — Online PPT Submission (via Unstop)
  • Teams must submit a PPT including:
  • Team details
  • Selected domain/track
  • Proposed solution idea
  • Submission Deadline: 11 November 2026
  • Evaluation Criteria:
  • Innovation
  • Feasibility
  • Scalability
  • Technical implementation
  • Problem statements will be available in the official brochure.

Round 2 — Onsite Hackathon

  • Date: 14 November 2026
  • Venue: NIT Agartala
  • Duration: 12-hour continuous hackathon
  • Shortlisted teams will build a working solution based on an extended version of their selected problem statement.

Prizes & Rewards

  • Total Prize Pool: ₹70,000
  • Additional Opportunities
  • Networking with developers and innovators
  • Real hackathon exposure
  • Collaboration and learning opportunities

Additional Information

  • Accommodation: Provided for shortlisted participants
  • Transportation: Not covered                                                       

Why TechNovus? 

  • Ideas are cheap.
  • Execution is rare.
  • This is a room full of people trying to execute.
  • Step in. Build boldly. Innovate with purpose.
